site.name: Compress
site.tagline: A design shelf: two free icon brands, Poppins, one palette, and two offline Android apps built from them.

tools.name: Compress
tools.summary: Pick photos, preview the settings with a before/after slider, then compress. Fully offline: the app has no internet permission at all.
features: Real quality: the encoder retries lower until the file actually gets smaller.
Downscale: cap the longest edge at 1280, 1920, 2560, 3200 or 4096 px, or keep the original.
Batch: up to 40 photos, per-file savings, then share them all in one go.
Orientation: EXIF rotation is applied to the pixels, so portrait shots stay upright.
Metadata: location and device tags are dropped during re-encode.
Non-destructive: copies go to Pictures/Compress, originals are untouched.
Verify: tapping a saved result reopens the slider so you can confirm the file matches the preview.

tools.name: Icons
tools.summary: Both free icon brands on the phone: 1,864 glyphs, a preview with weight, size and surface, and the whole set behind one toggle. Bundled offline with no permissions at all.
features: Two brands, 606 Lineicons and 1,258 Coolicons, bundled with the pages and the fonts.
Copy exports SVG, or a PNG, WEBP or JPG at 32-1024px drawn on the chosen background; the site also puts a PNG on the clipboard.
No content sits under the status bar or a camera cutout: the browser is inset.
Export the whole set, or whatever the filter shows, as one zip.
Black and white preview tiles, labelled plainly, for judging a glyph's contrast.
A preview tab whose weight, size and background repaint the glyph as you press.
The category you last picked is remembered per brand, and All icons forgets it.
Both brands filter by category, each with its vendor's own taxonomy, beside the name filter.
The whole set opens into a scrolling sheet instead of filling the page.
Copy hands over the untouched SVG: 24x24 viewBox, currentColor, no baked weight.
No INTERNET permission: the browser and the catalogs ship inside the APK.
The format, export size and background you pick are remembered per brand, like the category.
Export size opens a list of six sizes, from 32 to 1024px.

portfolio.title: Compress
portfolio.summary: An offline image compressor with a before/after slider, batch queue and per-file savings. No account, no uploads, no internet permission.
portfolio.built: The whole app: picker flow, preview pipeline, encoder retry loop, queue management, sharing, launcher icon and the settings screen.

portfolio.title: Icons app and browser
portfolio.summary: All 1,864 glyphs from two free brands with a live preview, variant controls and the set folded into a scrolling sheet; the same page ships as an offline Android app.
portfolio.built: The fetch pipeline, the two generated brand pages, the preview and variant logic, the collapsible set, the WebView wrapper that serves the bundle from a private origin, and the catalogs both read.
portfolio.stack: Vanilla JavaScript, Java WebView, Python fetch script

portfolio.title: This site
portfolio.summary: The shelf: catalogs for the tools, icons, fonts and work, all built from the same measurements as the apps and all readable as JSON.
portfolio.built: The measured layout, one shared stylesheet, the JSON builder that re-measures every shipped file, and the render gallery.
portfolio.stack: Hand-written HTML and CSS, Python build steps, static hosting
